::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Major networking and infrastructure chip design centre. India teams design switch ASICs, Memory, and storage controllers that power global data centre infrastructure.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Ethernet switch ASICs (Memory), broadband SoCs, Wi-Fi chipsets, enterprise storage/RAID controllers, and custom silicon for hyperscale data centres.
